author: claude
desc: STRATEGIC REDIRECT for USB, prompted by the Linux 7.0 Apple Silicon DT work (Phoronix, 2026-07). Upstream is landing the COMPLETE USB3 description for M1/M2: per port, an Apple Type-C PHY (atcphy), a combo PHY for USB2/USB3/USB4-TB/DP, a Synopsys dwc3 controller, TWO DART iommu instances, and a CD321x USB PD controller. That last element owns CC detection, data/power role and VBUS sourcing — which is precisely our blocker: the 2026-07-21 right-port smoke reached xHCI root hubs but no child device, because the bus-powered stick has no VBUS. Our apple,force-host-mode patch exists specifically because 'the current T6040 bring-up DT has no supported SPMI-HPM/Type-C connector path', i.e. we bypassed the very mechanism that would give us VBUS. VERIFIED PRESENT IN OUR TREE: the PD driver binds apple,cd321x (drivers/usb/typec/tipd/core.c:2024, with cd321x_status/struct cd321x/cd321x_read_data_status); the atcphy driver exists (drivers/phy/apple/atc.c) and is TUNABLE-DRIVEN from the ADT exactly like PCIe (apple,tunable-axi2af, -common-a/-common-b, -lane0/1-usb, -lane0/1-cio); and t602x-dieX.dtsi / t600x-dieX.dtsi already instantiate the whole stack as a working template. VERIFIED ABSENT: atcphy has only a t8103 compatible, and our t6040-j614s DT contains no atcphy, typec, cd321x or usb-role-switch node at all. TASK: adapt the t602x-dieX.dtsi pattern to t6040 with ADT-derived addresses and the ADT's own apple,tunable-* values, add a t6040 atcphy compatible, and describe the PD controller. macvdmtool reports hpm0 at i2c0@9B040000/AppleS5L8940XI2CController/hpmBusManager@6B/AppleHPMBusController/hpm0/AppleHPMARMI2C, so the PD controller is on I2C — check whether the right port's HPM sits on the same bus. WHY THIS MATTERS: if it works, it REPLACES the HPM R3 approach entirely — reviewed upstream drivers doing CC/PD instead of hand-rolled 4CC writes whose sequence is not even decoded (096). UNKNOWNS, do not assume: the article covers M1/M2 only, never M4/t6040/t6041; our notes call the part SN201202x while m1n1-hpm2 carries tps6598x.c, which makes the CD321x/TPS6598x family likely but NOT established; and whether M4's atcphy register layout matches t8103/t600x/t602x is unknown. Relates to 023 (atcphy-track-upstream), supersedes the urgency of 096/097 if it lands. Evidence: evidence/2026-07-26-t6040-usb-vbus-blocker-and-roleswap-decode-gap.md.
progress: 2026-07-27 SCOPED, AND IT LOOKS LIKE DT-ONLY WORK. Two findings that shrink this a lot. (1) UPSTREAM STATUS (Asahi 6.19 progress report): the Synopsys dwc3 and TI USB-PD controller driver changes are ALREADY MERGED; only the atcphy driver awaits review. And M3 support is 'about where M1 was at the first beta' with keyboard, touchpad, WiFi, NVMe and USB3 ALL WORKING behind local m1n1/kernel patches not yet PR'd — relevant because our own m1n1 pcie.c already types t6040 as APCIE_T6031/APCIE_T8122, i.e. M3-generation, so M3 work is the right base to track. (2) THE ATCPHY DRIVER IS ALREADY SoC-GENERIC. Both templates bind via a FALLBACK compatible: t600x-dieX.dtsi uses 'apple,t6000-atcphy','apple,t8103-atcphy' and t602x-dieX.dtsi uses 'apple,t6020-atcphy','apple,t8103-atcphy'. The driver only matches apple,t8103-atcphy — the SECOND entry — so the register layout is shared across M1, M1 Pro/Max and M2 and each SoC merely adds a specific first compatible. CONSEQUENCE: t6040 probably needs NO driver change; a node with compatible='apple,t6040-atcphy','apple,t8103-atcphy' would bind the existing driver. The work becomes DT: five reg entries with reg-names 'core','lpdptx','axi2af','usb2phy','pipehandler', #phy-cells=1, #reset-cells=0, orientation-switch, mode-switch, power-domains=<ps_atcN_usb>; plus the display-crossbar mux, the dwc3 node (reg-names 'dwc3-core','dwc3-apple', dr_mode='otg', usb-role-switch, role-switch-default-mode='host', two iommus, resets=<atcphyN>, phys=<atcphyN PHY_TYPE_USB2>,<atcphyN PHY_TYPE_USB3>), two DARTs, and the PD controller. All addresses ADT-derived, all apple,tunable-* values from the ADT exactly as PCIe does it. STILL UNVERIFIED: that the t6040 atcphy register layout actually matches (the shared compatible across three generations is strong evidence but not proof), and that the right port's PD controller is on the same I2C bus as hpm0. NOTE the dwc3 template uses dr_mode='otg' + usb-role-switch + role-switch-default-mode='host', which is the SUPPORTED way to get host mode — a proper replacement for our apple,force-host-mode hack. | 2026-07-27 ADT TOPOLOGY MAPPED OFFLINE, and it half-confirms, half-corrects the DT-only hope. Parsed the full J614s ADT (162 arm-io nodes) with m1n1 adt.py, no rig. CONFIRMED: Apple carries t6040-native compatibles — atc-phy2='atc-phy,t6040' (base 0x193000000, 44 regs), usb-drd2='usb-drd,t6040','usb-drd,t8132' (base 0x192280000), dart-usb2 with TWO dart instances (0x192f00000 + 0x192f80000). The upstream 5 reg-names map cleanly onto the ADT (core=0x193000000, usb2phy=0x192a90000, pipehandler=0x192a84000, axi2af=0x190000000; lpdptx in the dp/xbar nodes), matching the t602x template's low bits — so the PHY/dwc3/dart nodes ARE adaptable with real addresses now in hand. CORRECTION: the PD controller is NOT on I2C, so the upstream apple,cd321x I2C driver will NOT bind. Every i2c child enumerated: audio codecs (i2c1/2/3), sd-card (i2c4/0x20), ATC RETIMERS uatcrt0/1/2 'atcrt' (i2c6/0x18-0x1a), pcon0 (i2c8/0x08). The PD controller is SPMI (nub-spmi0..4, aapl,spmi) — consistent with the 092-097 SPMI HPM work and m1n1-hpm2's tps6598x.c, but it means VBUS/role sourcing does NOT come from the upstream I2C model. NET: the DATA path (atcphy+dwc3+retimers+darts) is DT-describable now; the VBUS path still runs through the SPMI PD controller (same wall as 096, roleSwap sequence still undecoded). NEW: uatcrt0/1/2 are ATC retimers (eUSB2/USB3 repeaters) our force-host DT never initialised — a second data-path piece independent of VBUS, on I2C. NEXT: author the atcphy/dwc3/dart/retimer DT nodes (prerequisite either way, no PD decode needed); VBUS stays blocked on 096 or a self-powered-device discriminator (maintainer-only). Evidence: evidence/2026-07-27-t6040-typec-adt-topology.md, evidence/2026-07-27-t6040-typec-adt-map.txt. | 2026-07-27 ADDRESS CORRECTION: the ADT addresses in the topology writeup are untranslated bus addresses; CPU-physical = raw + 0x200000000 (the /arm-io ranges delta), confirmed because usb-drd2 raw 0x192280000 + 0x200000000 = 0x392280000 = the working t6040.dtsi usb_drd2 node exactly. So CPU-physical: usb-drd2=0x392280000, atc-phy2=0x393000000, dart-usb2=0x392f00000/0x392f80000. The base t6040.dtsi already bakes in the translation, so build DT nodes from those (0x3xx) addresses, not the raw 0x1xx reads. | 2026-07-28 IRC — MEASURED t6040 ATC PHY TUNABLE INVENTORY reshapes this ticket (evidence/2026-07-28-asahi-dev-irc-review-0726-0728.md). yuka dumped the real t6040 atcphy set: 17 entries vs t8132's 44. CIO3PLL_* is RENAMED CIO4PLL_CORE ('they grew tb5 in t6040'); all ACIOPHY_*, AUSCMN_*, AUX_TOP, CIO_SHIM, CLKMON_CFG GONE; new AUS40CMN_SHM, UC_REGS_CIO_DFLT, USB2PHY_DFLT. Full list: ATC0AXI2AF, ATC0AXI2AF_LIOA, ATC_COMMON_CFG, ATC_FABRIC, AUS40CMN_SHM, AUSPLL_CORE, CIO4PLL_CORE, LN0/LN1_RX_CFG_TX_OF_RXCLK, LN0/LN1_RX_EQ_CIO_DFLT, LN0/LN1_RX_TOP_CIO_DFLT, UC_REGS_CIO_DFLT, USB2PHY_DEV, USB2PHY_DFLT, USB2PHY_HOST. CONSEQUENCE: apple,tunable-laneX-usb comes out EMPTY from adt2dt (only three *_CIO_* per-lane tunables exist); yuka's read is 'I doubt USB3 will work' (HYPOTHESIS, explicitly unresolved). HOPEFUL PRECEDENT (measured on t8132, NOT t6040): yuka got t8132 working with NO new tunables — existing t8122 table + alias ATC0AXI2AF->ATCAXI2AF. ALSO REQUIRED: apple,dart-vm-size is now MANDATORY on DART nodes (missing => 'failed to read apple,dart-vm-size: -22'; e.g. <0x0 0xa0000000>) — applies to the dart-usb2 nodes this ticket authors. Operational: 'atcphy does not start to do things unless you plug sth in'. Upstream shape to watch: yuka floated a 'reset-only' atcphy mode, close to our force-host approach. t6050 shares the same tunables. Upstream ATC: PR 639 (atc-phy,t8132 reusing t8122) + merged 639e0506 (LN0/LN1_RX_TOP_USB_EQA at 0x9000/0x10000). NOTE: this ticket is assigned to sol in the 2026-07-28 handoff prompt.
sol_update: 2026-07-28: authored a compile-checked, fail-closed right-port staging description in linux/arch/arm64/boot/dts/apple/t6040-{usb3-right-data-path.dtsi,j614s-dcuart-usb3-right-data-path-staging.dts}, mirrored byte-for-byte to wallace/dts. It preserves all 44 native ATC banks with +0x200000000 translation, wires DWC3 resets/USB2+USB3 phys/role switch, and inventories disabled I2C6 atcrt0/1/2. CORRECTION: do not add the t8103 atcphy fallback; the current driver probes by resetting/writing the incompatible old five-window layout. DTB compile/round-trip passes; all 44 compiled tuples equal the ADT; ATC, I2C6, and DWC3 remain disabled. 2026-07-29 CORRECTION: paired AppleHPM plus AppleTypeCRetimer analysis refutes the prior claim that enableOptions calls atcrt%u for a mode transition. AppleHPM uses the cached service only for panic-count publication/notification, while AppleTypeCRetimer's normal paths monitor health rather than program lane mode. The physical retimers remain disabled because power/clock/reset/firmware ownership is unknown, but an atcrt mode-control clone is not a demonstrated prerequisite for a reviewed USB2 data-path attempt. Guessed PS883x compatibles remain forbidden. 2026-07-29 UPSTREAM CHECK: Yuka already tried a five-window apple,t8122-atcphy fallback in 2849873b and retains it only on feature/t604x-usb-broken; the active feature/m4-usb branch excludes it. The commit itself cites CIO4/TB5 and reduced tunables. Paired T6040 USB2 evidence adds a direct mismatch: event bank 1 is 0x392800000, while the fallback's T8122 event access is core-relative at 0x393000000, and the probe performs immediate writes. Do not import unchanged. 2026-07-29 DRIVER SLICE: patches/0001-phy-apple-add-experimental-T6040-USB2-only-slice.patch maps only bank0/bank1, exposes only USB2 host, performs no probe-time ATC-register writes, and reproduces the exact paired RMW/delay/status sequence. Fresh arm64 container compile passes; patch bc7ba641, object dfba7f79. It has deliberately no inverse/power_off and is not applied by kbuild; the current full-path DT must not be enabled unchanged because it also requests USB3 and reset-provider behavior. HPM VBUS, a separate USB2-only DT, independent review, CJ approval/attendance, and power-cycle recovery remain gates. No runnable object and no rig time. Evidence: evidence/2026-07-28-t6040-usb3-right-data-path-dt-staging.md, evidence/2026-07-29-t6040-atcrt-owner-correction.md, evidence/2026-07-29-t6040-yuka-usb-branch-review.md, and evidence/2026-07-29-t6040-usb2-only-driver-slice.md.
